The flames are bright orange and yellow, licking at the edges of the meat, which is beginning to char. As the flames consume the food, the surface darkens, indicating it is being charred and consumed by fire. The metal surface beneath the food shows signs of wear, with visible scratches and marks, suggesting frequent use for cooking. The camera shows slight movement, capturing the transformation of the food as it is charred under the intense heat.

The camera remains steady throughout, focusing on the transformation of the food as it cooks under the intense heat. caption: A dark, fibrous lump with tan, hairy interior patches sits on a scratched metallic tabletop while bright orange flames burn across and around it. The flame coverage shifts continuously, sweeping in broad diagonal bands over the middle and left and wrapping around the left flank and base. Tongues rise at the top-left at times, while the fire elsewhere thins into a low ribbon hugging the bottom edge. As the flames lick the surface, the beige patches progressively blacken and the body grows more uniformly scorched. The right protrusion develops and maintains a charred crust studded with small red glowing embers. The lump remains in place, so the visible motion comes from the fluctuating flames and advancing charring.
